evidence: Counts match exactly — that's the independent audit, and it passed:
metric: disease 363,134 = 363,134; xref 2,600,229 = 2,600,229; ncats_ppi 11,691,825 = 11,691,825; about 30 s per full scan; 17 tables would take 8-10 min vs 169 s for one parser pass
observation: DuckDB has no mysqldump reader (its mysql extension needs a running server, and none of 439 community extensions parses a dump), but chdb, the in-process ClickHouse package, reads MySQLDump input directly. Its row counts matched the project parser on three tables including the 11.7M-row interaction table, giving an independent check on the custom reader.

title: chdb reads the dump natively and matches the project parser exactly
